name: loop-until-the-failing

spec.name: loop-until-the-failing
spec.prompt:
Loop until the failing test passes, then push it

When — and only when — all work is complete and verified, end your final message with exactly:

    <promise>COMPLETE</promise>

Do not emit that text early; the jobsite stops iterating the moment it appears.

notes: worktree reclamation is not a remote spec key: merge the branch, then delete it in the repository checkout
